column1: # ZAP rules for the nightly full scan against k3d, through Traefik (#1421). Read by dast.yml through `-c`.
# One line per rule: id, level, name. FAIL turns the run red. WARN is for the reader of the report.
# IGNORE silences the rule, and every IGNORE carries the date and the reason on the line above it,
# like `.trivyignore` — one without is a review finding. A `#` line is a comment to ZAP too.
# FAIL is what the chart guarantees or what no site should ever show: the headers
# `security-headers-middleware.yaml` sets on every response, no CSP missing, no server banner, no
# stack trace, no injection. A rule was promoted to FAIL only after it passed once, on 2026-09-14.
# A WARN with a note names the issue that will promote it.
# The ids and names come from the pinned image's `-g` output. A new rule in a newer image arrives
